speaker: alice
text: First up, the humpbacks are putting on one last show as they finish their migration south past our coastline. Spotters up and down from the Gold Coast to Hervey Bay reckon its been a cracker season for mums and calves this year.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah, and closer to home the bull sharks are back cruising up the Brisbane River, which sounds terrifying but honestly its just a sign the river systems ticking along nicely as the water warms up. Scientists love seeing them turn up right on schedule.

speaker: alice
text: Its basically natures version of the swallows coming back to Capistrano, except with a lot more teeth. Either way, its a good reminder spring in Queensland means the whole ecosystem wakes up at once.
